scope: Bounded full static read of prepared post-builder validation metadata helper; no execution or current canonical output audit.

checks.commandBoundary: Separate final-command snapshot; named qualification-first and precommit-normal-freeze exits0, ordinary staged-diff-check exit0or2 only.
checks.diagnostics: Full match of copied evidence path,line and two allowed whitespace categories; existing evidence-map membership and current copy/original exact hash/pin; trailing-plus text matched.
checks.exitMeaning: 0 requires no diagnostics;2 requires one or more individually verified diagnostics. No trim/ignoreflag/sourceguard change.
checks.copyScope: New regular bounded scanner-clean log/staticreview/runtime/helper bodies; content-addressed exclusive writes or comparison only.
checks.metadataScope: Newvalidation-summary plus generatedmap/refs/receipt artifacts updated; original receipt commands/test counters preserved.
checks.countBoundary: Frozen20 original root records and9causal commands remain separate; primary9 aggregatesmap7+telemetry2 across2runs.
checks.hashOrder: Mapping/refs then receipt artifacts; receipt excludes itself. No mutable helper-run log/journal-row self-reference is claimed.
checks.scannerAndCap: Split private-key sentinel; selected body and final artifact caps1MiB; no evidence-body trimming.
checks.partialAttempt: Nontransactional augmentation; late failure may leave summary/newcopies or generated metadata updates. No automatic retry/rollback implied.

scopeLimits: Relies on root-owned serial final-command metadata; does not independently query staged Git blob hashes or reconstruct actual commandargv/source.
Matches logged EOFblank line to a blank current immutable-body line; ordinary Git producer supplies the EOF classification. No adversarial-log guarantee.
The helper is an augmentation, not a replacement for canonical builder, receipt validator, actual staged-diff command or later independent evidence review.
Future expected review/command/Q files are prerequisites; their current readiness is not established here.
Final-command journal is point-in-time appendable metadata separate from frozen20; later checks need their own handoff evidence.
No original style result, formal/quality/ownership gap is waived.
